name: io.github.ZenRows/zenrows-mcp
description: Zenrows MCP server: Fetch, Extract, Batch, and Browser Sessions for AI agents

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Without it, the first tool call creates a Free account (5,000 credits/month) you can claim later. ZENROWS_AUTO_SIGNUP=false opts out. Keys: https://app.zenrows.com/account/settings
environmentVariables.name: ZENROWS_API_KEY

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <ZENROWS_API_KEY> or OAuth. Needed for tool calls only. No auto-signup; agents can POST https://app.zenrows.com/api/agent/signup for a key.
